verdict.rationale: Evidence shows Amplitude offers dashboards, charts, cohorts, and an AI natural-language query interface (which explicitly markets 'No SQL' as a benefit), plus REST/export APIs and warehouse integrations like BigQuery/Snowflake for data export — but nothing indicates an in-platform SQL or SQL-equivalent query editor over raw events. missing for 10: any documented SQL/notebook query interface inside Amplitude, evidence of a query language for ad-hoc raw event access, or hands-on confirmation of SQL support.
